narrative.headline: 2018 Chevrolet Silverado 1500: power train tops owner complaints
narrative.summary: Across 504 owner complaints to NHTSA, power train problems lead by a wide margin at 165 reports (33%), followed by electrical system, engine, and service brakes (each 96-97 reports, 19%). Owners describe sudden loss of power steering, stalling, and the engine shutting off while driving. Engine and electrical reports each include 2 fires, and service brakes account for 3 crashes.
